gotchas: myRyanair signup has no page of its own: on https://www.ryanair.com/gb/en click the header 'Log in' button, which opens a dialog holding an iframe (src https://www.ryanair.com/gb/en/kyc). Inside the iframe, 'Log into myRyanair' shows; click its 'Sign up' button to switch to 'New account setup'. Loading /gb/en/kyc top-level renders an empty page.
Cookie banner on load: click button[data-ref="cookie.no-thanks"] ('No, thanks').

All signup fields are inside that iframe: use page.frameLocator('iframe[src*="/kyc"]') with input[name="email"], input[name="password"] and button:has-text("Create account") (each matched exactly once inside the frame). Only email + password are asked; there is no name, DOB or confirm-password field at signup. Google, Facebook and PayPal social buttons sit above the form.
Account creation sends a verification email in Ryanair's normal flow (not observed here); the 'New account setup' form was not submitted.
Password rule shown in a tooltip: at least 8 chars, one number, one lower, one upper; a 20-char password with symbols was accepted.
After 'Create account' the kyc frame shows an email verification-code screen (owner step).
